title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg predicts billions will have a personal AI agent working in next five years
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has predicted that billions of people could have their own personal AI agents within the next five years. These AI systems, he said, would understand users’ goals and work for them around the clock. Speaking during Meta’s quarterly earnings call, Mark Zuckerberg said personal AI agents could eventually help people with areas including money, health, relationships and managing their homes. He also expects WhatsApp and Meta’s other messaging services to play an important role as people begin interacting with multiple AI agents.

title: NXP aims for AI expertise for the automotive industry through the acquisition of Ambarella
